comparisons.peer_summary: Marketing, general and administrative expenses were $2.8 billion in 2024, an increase of $431 million or 18% from $2.4 billion in 2023, primarily due to increased go-to-market activities supporting revenue growth.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD reported increases in their respective administrative operating expenses (SG&A for AVGO and MG&A for AMD) driven primarily by headcount and compensation. While both cite headcount/compensation as a driver, AVGO explicitly links the volume to a merger integration and equity valuation, whereas AMD links it to supporting revenue growth activities.
